checks.name: 삼성전자 편입 ETF 시가총액 1위
checks.sql: SELECT coalesce(e.pd_abrv_nm, c.etf_name) AS nm FROM etf_constituent c LEFT JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.du_clpr AS DOUBLE)*TRY_CAST(e.pd_lst_stk_cnt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
